name: aws-diagram-design
description: AWS-branded editorial diagrams: architecture, VPC, flowchart, sequence, ER, timeline, swimlane, Gantt, data flow and 18 more types as standalone HTML/SVG/PNG — Amazon Ember typography, squid ink + smile orange skin, official AWS Architecture Icons bundled. Redraws .drawio and Mermaid sources, exports PNG/SVG, and draws read-only current-state diagrams from a live AWS account. Korean triggers: AWS 아키텍처 다이어그램, 구성도, 흐름도, 시퀀스 다이어그램.
